methodology.fx_description: Nominal foreign exchange rates representing annual market spot conversion values to US Dollars (USD). Sourced from central banks and IMF International Financial Statistics (IFS).
methodology.ppp_description: Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) conversion factor for private consumption from the World Bank International Comparison Program (ICP) 2024 revision (measured in domestic currency per international dollar).
methodology.separation_warning: CRITICAL METHODOLOGICAL INVARIANT: Nominal FX conversion reflects external financial exchange value and international capital transfer parity. Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) reflects domestic consumption purchasing equivalence within local price structures. These metrics serve fundamentally different economic functions and MUST NEVER be averaged, blended, or used interchangeably.

GBP.fx_source: Bank of England Daily Spot Rates / IMF IFS 2024

AUD.fx_source: Reserve Bank of Australia / IMF IFS 2024

INR.fx_source: Reserve Bank of India Reference Rate 2024
INR.ppp_source: World Bank ICP 2024 Private Consumption PPP Factor
